BiblicalUsage: Génnēsis means birth, or nativity. It never actually appears in the Greek New Testament as it stands, so there is no passage to point to — the word lives in the lexicon, not in a verse.
TheologicalSignificance: I take génnēsis honestly: a word with no verse behind it, and I will not pretend otherwise.
